executiveSummary: Severe, ongoing floods in Nepal continue one month on, with thousands still displaced, damaged roads and bridges, and elevated WASH and landslide risks. Supporting Report Typhoon Dujuan caused deadly flooding and major transport disruption near Tokyo: at least four dead, six missing, 45,000 homes without power, and widespread flight and rail cancellations. View Article Northern and central Vietnam reported at least four fatalities, more than 16,000 homes inundated, and evacuations as riverine flooding spread across multiple provinces. Source Lethal flash flooding across the Navajo Nation killed three people, damaged roads, and isolated communities, prompting evacuations and emergency warnings. Source In Arizona's Grand Canyon, the flood death toll rose to three after a missing hiker was found deceased; access disruptions followed earlier evacuations. Source Approaching Hurricane Polo threatened Mexico's Pacific coast with heavy rain, coastal surf, and flooding/mudslide risks to communities and transport. View Article A rapidly spreading wildfire near Villa de Leyva, Colombia triggered a public calamity declaration, preventive evacuations, school closures, and hotel evacuations. Source Two firefighting pilots died during wildfire response in California's Yosemite area, underscoring operational hazards even where civilian infrastructure impacts remain limited. Source

outlook72h: Nepal: Continued rains and saturated soils sustain flood and landslide risks; prioritize access mapping and WASH mitigation in isolated communities. Supporting Report Pacific Mexico (Guerrero-Michoacan): Anticipate heavy rain, rough surf, localized flooding/mudslides as Hurricane Polo influences coastal conditions; monitor road access and small river basins. View Article Japan (Kanto): Residual flooding and landslide hotspots persist post-typhoon; expect continued transport and utility restoration operations. Source Vietnam: Monitor river levels and inundated communities for secondary displacement and WASH needs as receding waters expose damage. Source
regionalTrends: Asia Flood Concentration: Concurrent monsoon-season flooding and a typhoon landfall produced the week's heaviest human and infrastructure impacts (Nepal, Japan, Vietnam).
Americas Mixed Hazards: Flash flooding in the U.S. Southwest coincided with a significant wildfire in Colombia and a Pacific hurricane threat to Mexico.
Landslide Risk: Prolonged rainfall on steep terrain (notably in Nepal and Japan) elevates secondary landslide hazard and compound access challenges.
Operational Safety: Wildfire response remains high-risk, evidenced by responder fatalities in California.
